subject: Re: 2880 Lauren Heights Dr
comment: Just one more thought, if you allow this acception you will be setting a president for additional homes going higher and higher, blocking the view of Mount Olympus and the reason many of us moved here. We do not need to make this community look like Draper or Daybreak, please keep Millcreek and Elizabeth Heights the way it was intended by Mr Colemere, the original founder of the neighborhood. If you need an example of out of place homes take a look at the new home built a few years ago when the Harker home burnt down on 3400 south. Yes it is a lovely home, but it totally does not fit in the neighborhood. It has taken away our view of Mount Olympus almost entirely. Please do not make this acception. Thank you. On Tue, Jun 28, 2022, 10:05 PM Jan Kontgis < > wrote: Hello, This email is concerning the proposed home to be built at 2880 Lauren Heights Dr. I have been a resident on Colemere Way for the past 30 years, I have watched as neighbors have upgraded their homes and created additional space well within the current variance and allowable height restrictions. The new home that is proposed to be built does not fall under these guidelines. The style is also something that will not mix well with the mid century modern vibe of the neighborhood. Please understand I have nothing against the Queen Ann style of this home but it simply does not fit with the rest of the surrounding homes. The proposal also states that there are "taller commercial" buildings to the east and north of the property. This is not true, the post office and Kentucky Fried Chicken buildings are one story structures. The surrounding homes to 2880 are within the 28 foot varience. Allowing an additional 8 to 10 feet for this monstrosity would block the mountain view of many neighbors and create an eyesore on our neighborhood. Please keep Elizabeth Heights the way it was intended to be a quiet quaint, humble neighborhood, Mc Mansions are not fitting for this community. Thank you for your time
